virtual_anatomical_frame.origin: Named live Wuji wrist body origin
virtual_anatomical_frame.x: Distal direction from body origin to mean of four non-thumb named MCP anchors
virtual_anatomical_frame.y: Index-from-pinky MCP direction after orthogonalization to x
virtual_anatomical_frame.z: Cross product of x and y
virtual_anatomical_frame.normal: Positive z on the left; negative z on the right
virtual_anatomical_frame.scope: Robot-model coordinate convention only. Human marker attachment is unmeasured.
